Batch: 25 runs. 6 accepted, 6 declined, 13 not reported.
Flagged (5), reason width_free_ratio_used: r05, r13, r16, r19, r24. They passed rigid-body invariance and closure, and their centre REGR peak, peak position and growth-zone length match the batch. But each run used the width-free ratio without registration. All five have a largest flank difference of about -3.4 to -3.9 %/h, which matches their plane-sections values just above the 3.25 threshold. Their width-free ratio is near -0.45. Width-free runs with registered frames (r17, r01, r12, r14, r18) have plane-sections values of 0.6 to 1.3 %/h, flank differences near ±1 %/h and ratios near 0. This suggests the flank difference comes from uncorrected motion between frames, not a change in root width.
Cleared (1): r17. Frames were registered on non-growing tissue. Rigid invariance was 0.821 (threshold 2.0) and closure 0.451 (threshold 1.0). The plane-sections value was low at 0.571, and every summary had |z| of 1.38 or less.
What the flagged runs share: one kept remedy (the width-free ratio), no registration, and the same flank-difference and curvature-rate signature. Their centre strain-rate profiles may be reliable, but their flank differences and width-free ratios should be checked again with registered frames.
